name: Infiltration
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
At last we begin to hear word and rumor, find evidence of Gol'dir's whereabouts. The humans have been moving him around, but we are narrowing down our search and focusing on the large Syndicate camp just north of here.

Go there, adventurer, and bring back whatever information you can get your hands on.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve information about Gol'dir's whereabouts for Krusk in Tarren Mill.
narrative.offerRewardText: Finally, we know where Gol'dir is being held. The camp in question is not too far from here, and hopefully they will not be as well prepared as they were when they captured us the first time.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found anything? I fear Gol'dir's prospects grow worse by the day...

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 22 to 42, 18,000 XP in all.

quests.name: The Rescue
quests.objectiveText: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.

quests.name: Infiltration
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve information about Gol'dir's whereabouts for Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Gol'dir
quests.objectiveText: Free Gol'dir then return to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Blackmoore's Legacy
quests.objectiveText: Return the information gathered by Gol'dir to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
quests.objectiveText: Kill Lord Aliden Perenolde and ask his mistress, Elysa, about Taretha's pendant.

quests.name: Taretha's Gift
quests.objectiveText: Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
